description: Family apartment located in the heart of Paris. Monuments such as the Louvre, Notre-Dame and the Marais district are within walking distance.On a lively street, but quiet on the courtyard, your future base in Paris is on the 3rd floor, with elevator. Over 100 m2, the apartment has:- a living room with dining area- a fully equipped kitchen- 3 bedrooms, with double beds- 2 bathrooms.Total capacity of 8 people. Bedding and towels provided.Other things to noteTo access the elevator, half a floor is to be climbed by stairs.
